profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Currently working at Scale AI as a full stack engineer, helping to improve products and processes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Enable agentic data collection on contributor tasking platform, unlocking efficient data collection
* Mentor more junior engineers within the team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Increase data labeling throughput by x% by changing how labeling tasks reviews are done
* Enable tasking experience to be compatible with external integrations
* Create operator tooling for v2 tasking platform (bringing platform from 0 -> 1)
* Improve data auditing experience with a new, more scalable speed audit tool

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Increase stability of our automations product by more intelligently storing the product’s output data, allowing customers to use automations with a larger subset of their data
• Migrate sync system to use a “push” model using our internal notifications system rather than use a polling/“pull” model, allowing our slowest syncs to be completed within 5 seconds rather than minutes
• Optimize sync product to cut down on infrastructure CPU load by 40%
• Support customers with engineering-related issues with the product
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Node.js · Software Design · TypeScript · MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Increase scalability of current system by migrating one of our existing components to DynamoDB for easy autoscaling
• Implement proof of concept for long-term scalability of permission platform using Aurora Postgres database and AWS Serverless Lambda
• Create software that easily onboards most new customers onto permissions platform
• Help maintain permissions production system supporting more than 100 million requests daily
positions.insights: Skills: Cassandra · Kotlin · PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Help develop firmware and GUI for E-Chem board in order to determine the electrical behavior of chemicals and other particles
•	GUI, implemented in Java, gives users a variety of options to customize board settings for optimal measurements
•	Firmware for board implemented in C

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Instructor
positions.description: Teaching EE16B (designing information devices and systems)

positions.title: Group Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored EE16B (designing information devices and systems) students to deepen their understanding of Electrical Engineering concepts, including control theory and circuit design
Assisted students to work on a robotic car project, using speech recognition to control

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Develop new continuous integration and deployment pipeline, with a way to easily rollback changes
Create script to automate release pages published to Confluence, saving engineering time
Create service monitoring dashboards on SignalFX via Terraform code

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
• Improve developer productivity by automating tracking of internal library tools
• Develop visualization tool to enable engineering and sales teams to quickly visualize large sets of product version data in order to make business decisions

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern in Test
positions.description:
Work with the imaging team to improve and ensure quality of heart-imaging algorithms
Help improve performance of imaging algorithms and tests
Automate testing tools in order to streamline the software verification and validation process

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developing website to improve product (advanced investment algorithms) outreach
Website lets customers request investment services
